name: ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India Ltd
title: ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India Ltd - 533023 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue ₹4,302 cr (+9.2%) and Q4 PBT +16.4%, but Q4 margins fell ~230 bps QoQ on aluminium and Middle East cost pressure; FY27 capex ₹180–190 cr with margins guided flattish.

utilisation.quote: Mahindra World City, I would say the overall plant utilization is at almost peak level.

capex.quote: We're looking at about a spend of about INR 180 crores to INR 190 crores.

triggers.label: Aluminium ₹233 → ₹274/kg
triggers.quote: Aluminum as a commodity has been increased from almost INR 233 per kg to INR 274 per kg approximately.

triggers.label: FY27 capex ₹180–190 cr
triggers.quote: We're looking at about a spend of about INR 180 crores to INR 190 crores.

triggers.label: Q4 Americas revenue down ~22%
triggers.quote: there was a degrowth in the Americas of about 22%.

triggers.label: FY27 margin flattish, single-digit growth
triggers.quote: I would expect it to be more or less flattish with maybe single-digit small growth for the next year.

guidance.quote: I would expect it to be more or less flattish with maybe single-digit small growth for the next year.
We're looking at about a spend of about INR 180 crores to INR 190 crores.
we anticipate moderate improvement in export demand.

red_flags.label: Q4 margin compression on input costs
red_flags.quote: you see an increase in cost compared to the revenue recorded during the quarter.

red_flags.label: Q3 value/vehicle boosted by one-offs
red_flags.quote: It was related to certain selling price variances that we got from customers. Those were some one-timers

evasions.quote: very difficult to call out on -- given the macroeconomic situation, I would be cautious on the call out for financial year '26, '27.
We are getting some new RFQs, I would say, and that's ongoing.
